name: ism-design-system
description: ISM Design System: the source of truth for ISM websites, apps and digital products (web, React, Next.js, React Native, iOS, Android).

scripts.build: npm run build:tokens && npm run build:icons && npm run build --workspace @ism/web && npm run build:specs && npm run sync:native && npm run build:previews && npm run build:dtcg && npm run build:lint-data && npm run build:prompts && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run check:tokens && npm run check:icons && npm run check:native && npm run check:specs && npm run validate && npm run check:dtcg && npm run check:screenshots && npm run check:prompts && npm run check:lint-data && npm run lint:usage && npm run test:lint
scripts.build:site: npm run build:previews && npm run build:dtcg && npm run build:lint-data && npm run build:prompts && node scripts/build-site.mjs
